items.title: Шия Ли
items.alt: Li Shiya 李诗雅
items.description: Юань Цзюньтан и Ли Шия успешно пожали друг другу руки, и у них начался романтический роман, о котором все мечтали в студенческом городке. Однако по мере того, как сладкое послевкусие постепенно проходит, как и ожидалось, появляются чувства неполноценности, замешательства и проблем с ростом. Когда страстная любовь сталкивается с реалистичными мечтами, они колеблются между компромиссом и тем, чтобы быть бок о бок, и эта симфония молодости в конечном счете столкнется со своим окончательным решением.

en: Li Shiya

Yuan Juntang and Li Shiya successfully joined hands, beginning the dream campus romance everyone had dreamed of. However, as the sweet filter gradually fades, feelings of inferiority, confusion, and growing pains arrive as expected. When passionate love collides with realistic dreams, they tug between compromise and being side by side, and this symphony of youth will ultimately face its final decision.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

items.title: Перелётные птицы и улитка
items.alt: Wataridori to Katatsumuri 渡り鳥とカタツムリ
items.description: Унпэй Мотидзуки — сотрудник оптовой фирмы по продаже запчастей, работающий там уже второй год, — совершает ошибку, из-за которой у клиентов компании возникают серьёзные проблемы. Расстроенный случившимся, он всерьёз задумывается о том, чтобы сбежать куда-нибудь, где его никто не знает. Именно тогда он встречает Цугуми Нагису — автора детских книжек с иллюстрациями, обладательницу по-юношески свежего лица и очков, которая путешествует вместе со своей собакой на машине, служащей ей одновременно и домом. Так начинаются их дни в дороге: они живут прямо в автомобиле, наслаждаясь новым для себя способом путешествовать — свободным от какого-либо расписания.

en: Wataridori to Katatsumuri

Unpei Mochizuki had been working for two years as a spare parts dealer. After making a mistake, he had only one wish: to go far, where no one can recognize him. That’s when he crosses paths with Tsugumi Nagisa, illustrator… and nomad. A woman of indefinable age, who lives with her dog in a van. Unpei begins a new life on the road with Tsugumi and her car. Far from the usual tidy, sedentary lifestyle, the nomadic spirit offers new surprises every single day. From beaches to mountains, from the North to the South… Freedom and endless new landscapes await!



(Source: Noeve grafx, translated)

items.title: От несчастного до сильнейшего
items.alt: Fuun kara no Saikyou Otoko 不運からの最強男
items.description: «Удача и неудача — две стороны одной монеты?! Обрати вспять любого противника и положи конец искуплению!!» После несчастного случая в прошлой жизни Зигберт перерождается заново. Его новая семья тёплая и радушная — настолько, что кажется, будто невезение осталось в прошлом. В этом мире он наконец-то сможет жить тихой, спокойной жизнью... или так он думал. Похоже, в этом новом мире он обладает просто невероятно высоким показателем удачи?.. «Каждый шанс — это проявление удачи. Если сумеешь исчерпать все шансы, твои желания исполнятся...» Покоряя один за другим «шансы», дарованные его удачей, сможет ли он теперь положить конец многолетнему бремени, что несёт на себе эта семья, и наконец исполнить давнее наследие рода?!

en: Fuun kara no Saikyou Otoko

"Fortune and Misfortune are two sides of the same coin?! Reverse any adversary and cease redemption!!" 



Siegbert is reborn after an unfortunate accident in his previous life. His new family is warm and welcoming... so much so it seems as though he may no longer be an unlucky person. In this world, he can finally live a quiet, peaceful life... or so he thought. It seems that he actually holds an insanely high luck stat in this new world...?



"Every chance is a manifestation of good fortune. If you can cease the chances, your wishes shall be granted..." Conquering each "chance" granted by his good fortune, will he now cease redemption on the generational legacy this family has yet to fulfill?!



(Source: MangaPlaza)

items.title: Hen Chun Hen Aimei
items.alt: 很纯很暧昧
items.description:
High school student Yang Ming is a typical underachiever. He gets into fights, skips class, and cheats on his schoolwork. When the school flower confronts him, he feels ashamed and wants to change, but he has fallen too far behind. However, by a stroke of fate, he ends up gaining a pair of contacts that allow him to change his visual perspective, completely altering the course of his future!



(Source: Webnovel)

en: Hen Chun Hen Aimei

High school student Yang Ming is a typical underachiever. He gets into fights, skips class, and cheats on his schoolwork. When the school flower confronts him, he feels ashamed and wants to change, but he has fallen too far behind. However, by a stroke of fate, he ends up gaining a pair of contacts that allow him to change his visual perspective, completely altering the course of his future!



(Source: Webnovel)

en: Juuheisou-gata Joshikousei

As a mysterious girl gazes into the distant sky and a high school girl named Ichi stands still, the story follows what they will see within this devastated world and what kind of tale they will weave.



(Source: MAL News)

items.title: J⇔M
items.alt: J⇔M
items.description:
J is a professional hitman...he was orphan and raised by a syndicate as an assassin. He was too good, killed too many people, knew too much about the syndicate.
When the syndicate tried to erase him, they were backfired...when three syndicates were wiped out completely, J became "untouchable."



Megumi, a girl in third grade, was bullied by her classmates because she is half-Japanese, half-American and gets good grades. One day, when they bumped their heads...their bodies were switched. Now J is inside a cute girl's body...and Megumi is inside the tough guy's body.



Now they must hide that they are not who they were and keep their everyday life look the same as before.
J never knew how hard a girl's life is, and Megumi enjoys her new life!?



(Source: BookWalker)

items.description: Ветеран-искатель приключений Хакура прошёл через бессчётное множество испытаний, но недавняя схватка со смертоносной гидрой едва не стоила ему жизни. В последний момент его спасает загадочная девушка по имени Рин, которая, к его удивлению, обладает редчайшим даром — способностью приручать абсолютно любых монстров! Оказавшись в долгу перед этой беспринципной укротительницей чудовищ, Хакура решает присоединиться к её странствиям, и с этого момента их путь превращается в бесконечную череду перепалок и споров. Что же свело этих двоих вместе, и какие приключения ждут столь неожиданный дуэт?

en: Mamonotsukai no Musume

Veteran adventurer Hakura has overcome countless trials, but his latest fight with a deadly hydra nearly costs him his life. In the nick of time, he is saved by an intriguing young lady named Leen, who, to his surprise, possesses the rare ability to tame any and all monsters! Now indebted to this unscrupulous monstermancer, Hakura decides to join her in her travels, the two of them arguing and bickering every step of the way. What has drawn them together, and what adventures await this unlikely pair?



(Source: J-Novel Club)

items.title: Э? Вы увольняете меня — единственную, кто в одиночку тянет всю внутреннюю систему компании?
items.originalTitle: E, Shanai System Subete One Operation shiteiru Watashi wo Kaiko desu ka?
items.alt: E, Shanai System Subete One Operation shiteiru Watashi wo Kaiko desu ka? え、社内システム全てワンオペしている私を解雇ですか？
items.description: Ай Сато — единственный инженер, отвечающий за внутренние системы своей компании. Увы, даже незаменимость не спасает от внезапных сокращений: новому директору почему-то не нравится, когда сотрудники косплеят на рабочем месте.В подавленном настроении и без работы Ай неожиданно встречает друга детства, Кенту Судзуки, который предлагает ей кое-что интересное. Его стартап, True Coding School, помогает людям, изнемогающим под гнётом современной жизни, с помощью индивидуальных занятий — и он зовёт её присоединиться к команде.С каждым уроком — искренним, а порой и весьма нестандартным — Ай замечает, как возвращает своим ученикам смысл жизни. Кто бы мог подумать, что простые уроки программирования способны изменить столько судеб?

en: E, Shanai System Subete One Operation shiteiru Watashi wo Kaiko desu ka?

Once the sole engineer maintaining the systems at her company, Ai Sato is laid off without warning one day. (Apparently, the new CEO doesn't approve of cosplaying at work... Rude!) Moping won't pay the bills, so Ai sets out to find a new job—only to bump into an old friend, Kenta Suzuki, who just so happens to need a business partner. Together, they'll run a coding school for people truly in need.



Their first student is of course...a salaryman hoping to improve his relationship with his family? Each new recruit that follows seems to be struggling under modern expectations: from a harried woman determined to prove her worth at work, to a jobless hopeful who wants to fulfill his mother's dream, and more. If Ai wants to bring out their best, she'll need to teach them a lesson in not just coding skills but also how to build up their confidence!



(Source: J-Novel Club)
ja: え、社内システム全てワンオペしている私を解雇ですか？

items.title: Брак с главным врагом организации оказался чересчур сладким
items.originalTitle: Soshiki no Shukuteki to Kekkon shitara Mecha Amai
items.alt: Soshiki no Shukuteki to Kekkon shitara Mecha Amai 組織の宿敵と結婚したらめちゃ甘い
items.description:
They used to be sworn enemies. Now they’re sworn spouses.



Roshi Saigawa and Ritsuka Nagira were once bitter rivals, each fighting for supremacy within rival organizations of superpowered warriors. Their days were filled with duels, schemes, and a rivalry so fierce it seemed nothing could ever bridge the gap between them. Yet, somehow, the impossible has happened— they’re now happily married!



From bitter enemies to star-crossed lovers, these two have traded their weapons for wedding vows, and their former battles have given way to laughter, love, and the everyday chaos of newlywed life.



But just because they’ve left the battlefield behind doesn’t mean life has gotten easier. Old rivalries resurface, secrets linger, and the lines between love, rivalry, and sheer chaos blur in ways neither of them expected. From laugh-out-loud domestic disasters to heart-melting romantic moments, Roshi and Ritsuka are about to prove that falling in love with your enemy isn’t just possible— it’ s explosive.



Full of humor, heart, and sizzling chemistry, this enemies-to-lovers rom-com will keep you laughing, swooning, and turning pages until the very last!



(Source: One Peace Books)

items.title: Я стал королём, пожирая монстров
items.originalTitle: Monster no Niku wo Kutteitara Oui ni Tsuita Ken
items.alt: Monster no Niku wo Kutteitara Oui ni Tsuita Ken モンスターの肉を食っていたら王位に就いた件
items.description:
Eat Or Die!



The first prince of the kingdom of Farune, Mars, is only twelve years old, yet he lives in fear of assassination. In order to avoid the deadly poison in nearly all of his meals, he slips out of the castle into the nearby monster-infested forest, where, battling monsters and his own hunger, he has to hunt for his meals in order to stave off starvation. Then, one night, as he’s searching for his next bite of monster meat, a red-haired woman shouldering a greatsword appears before him and says to him, “You have promise. Become my apprentice.” How is he supposed to tell her that this must be some sort of mistake? But there’s a secret that only she knows, and that he’s stumbled upon: eating monsters makes you stronger! With her training and his newfound power, Mars will finally overcome all those pesky assassination attempts. However, that doesn’t end things; no, it’s only the beginning of a nationwide—even continent-spanning—series of wars and plots with him right in the middle!



(Source: Cross Infinite World)

items.title: Жизнь Хинагику
items.alt: Hinagiku no Jinsei ひな菊の人生
items.description:
Hinagiku lost her only family member, her mother, in an accident when she was a child. On a long and lonely rainy season night, little Hinagiku played her flute alone. Her only support was her best friend, Dahlia, who came to her every time she heard the sound. More than ten years have passed since Dahlia left for Brazil, her mother's homeland. As an adult, Hinagiku lives with her aunt and uncle in their restaurant, making Yakisoba. One day during the rainy season, in the same downpour as the night Hinagiku lost her mother, a news arrives from Brazil. That news describes the supernatural connection between two lonely souls, far away from each other and never to be seen again―――.



(Source: amepippin)

items.description:
Six years ago, a massive explosion occurred in the town of Ouma, but miraculously, there were no fatalities.



In this town, where a mysterious sphere called "Glass Sun" floats in the sky, a boy named Kagari Mera, who feels out of place and lives a boring life, meets a mysterious girl named Thirteen on his 16th birthday.



His encounter with her brings vibrant color to Mera's previously monochrome life, but at the same time, strange occurrences begin to happen in the town.


(Source: Official Site, translated)

items.title: Megazone 23 XI
items.alt: メガゾーン23 XI
items.description:
The story is set aboard the Megazone 11, a different space colony ship fleet from the Megazone 23 in the 1985 original video anime. Megazone 11's master ships are designed as realistic simulations of Earth cities such as Tokyo, and there is also a satellite ship that is designed to resemble a smaller Japanese provincial city around the year 2020.

The protagonist Sakura is an ordinary second-year middle school student who lives aboard that satellite ship. She leads a secret life as part of a singing duo with Eve, a friend she made online. On a master ship, a resistance movement flares up. To achieve independence, they must take control of Tiamat, the system that controls the fleet, but the key to the system was lost in battle 80 years ago. With rumors of its reappearance surfacing, both the resistance and the government are seeking the key. One day, while visiting Akihabara on the Tokyo ship to meet Eve, Sakura is embroiled in the middle of a terrorist attack at the train station. As Eve remotely guides Sakura to safety, Sakura comes across Garland XI, a transforming motorcycle robot mecha that Eve tells her to use.





(Source: Anime News Network)

items.description:
Every family has its own "secrets"... Meet our protagonist, Shota Minamoto, a junior-high school student who also happens to be an orphan in a children's home. One day, he was adopted by a family living in a luxurious, Japanese-style estate. Welcomed warmly by them all, Shota started letting his guard down but this family had a "secret" that the world could never know.



A new work from the creator of "The Cuckoo's Fiance" showcasing a different kind of "family." Thus begins a cozy, bloody love comedy!



(Source: K-Manga)

Она употребляла демонические ядра с детства, изменяя свое телосложение, и демон, из-за небесной скорби, больше не мог заботиться о ней. Священник взял девушку в ученицы, дав ей даосское имя Шан Шань Шан, и они вдвоем начали свое путешествие по миру людей, побеждая демонов и изгоняя злых духов.

en: Shang Shan

Douzen, a Taoist priest who travels the land, one day encounters a young girl raised by a yokai. Unfamiliar with human emotions or affection, Douzen gives her the name Shouzen and decides to take her along on his travels as his disciple. What is goodness? What is love? Thus begins a journey of spiritual training for Shouzen as she grows into a human being.



(Source: Fuji TV, translated)

items.alt: Tsuihou sareta Shounin wa Kane no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukuu 追放された商人は金の力で世界を救う
items.description:
Torao, a merchant with an unpopular profession, was a member of an S-rank adventurer party. However, being mediocre in combat and caught embezzling funds, he is told: "You're fired!" And just like that, he's expelled from the party. Left with no choice, Torao teams up with the girls on whom he spent the embezzled money, aiming to defeat the Demon Lord. But their first job is shockingly to recover equipment from the corpses of his annihilated former party...!?


"It doesn't matter. You're not my comrades anymore."


Even if they say, "We always thought we were comrades," it's too late now...

Masamune's armor is called Oryu; however, the robot is too strong for the young Masamune to control, which leads to the death of many people. Fearing the power of Oryu, the other daimyo form an alliance against Masamune in order to destroy it.



(Source: Anime News Network)

items.title: Вечная любовь
items.alt: Nan Hong 难哄
items.description: Когда Вэнь Ифань Вэнь вернулась в родной город по работе, она неожиданно столкнулась в баре с тем самым легендарным «Красавцем номер один». Однако вскоре выяснилось, что это Сан Янь Сан — тот самый парень, которого она когда-то обидела и отвергла ещё в старшей школе. По иронии судьбы эти двое, которые никак не могли поладить друг с другом, постоянно пересекались на жизненном пути. Более того, они случайно сняли одну и ту же квартиру и стали соседями по дому. Невысказанные чувства, глубоко запрятанные внутри, начинают понемногу пробуждаться...Давайте же посмотрим, как Сан Янь — воплощение идеального парня — раскрывает и выражает свою искреннюю привязанность и нежную любовь!

en: Nan Hong

When Wen Yifan returned to her hometown for work, she unexpectedly ran into the rumored "First-Class Handsome Guy" at a bar. However, she soon discovered that he was Sang Yan, someone she had hurt and rejected in high school. In a twist of fate, these two individuals who could never get along found themselves constantly crossing paths. They even ended up renting the same unit by chance and becoming housemates. With unspoken feelings buried deep within, strong emotions begin to stir...



Let's see how Sang Yan, the "Peak Ideal Boyfriend," interprets and expresses his profound affection and sweet love!



(Source: INKR)

items.title: Тысяча любовей и мириады цветов
items.alt: Senren*Banka 千恋＊万花
items.description:
The village of Hoori lies deep in the middle of the mountains, inaccessible by rail. Since there isn’t much interaction with its surroundings, the town seems like it is stuck in the past. However, it is because of this exact olden feel and subsequent development that it has turned into a nice hot-springs town for tourists.



One of the popular sightseeing spots is the legendary katana Murasamemaru, embedded in stone. No one has been able to pull it out… until Masaomi somehow broke it in half. He has to take responsibility for his actions: “Marriage” with ‘shrine maiden princess’ Yoshino!? He was perplexed at the unexpected turn of events, but this is only just the beginning. What lies ahead for him is a much more peculiar and mysterious life, including his new fiancée, a mysterious girl who only he could touch, and the secret behind the curse that remains on the town.



What will become of Masaomi’s love amidst his rapidly changing life? The answer lies within the Murasamemaru in his hands.



(Source: VNDB)

items.description:
In a hyper-competitive society, where the gap between rich and poor is widening,a flawless existence are demanded, and only the strongest survive.
Struggling and writhing amidst it all, can they reclaim what they've lost...?



Those who possess talent, yet have been pushed aside because of past mistakes or the circumstances they were born into. For them, a new beginning is offered — a hidden street basketball league known as ZERO RISE.



Only those who fight their way to victory can erase their past scars and reclaim the stage. Not only trained basketball players can step into this fight. Risking it all and pushing themselves to the limit, every kind of underdog gathers.


As they fight to RISE up from ZERO.


(Source: ZERO RISE English site)

items.title: Kyoukai no Melody
items.alt: 境界のメロディ
items.description:
Kyousuke, who lost his partner Kai in an accident just before their major debut, has distanced himself from music and lived listlessly. But three years after the accident, Kai suddenly appeared before Kyousuke.



"Even if you're alive, if you just stop and do nothing, it's the same as being dead, right?"  



His blunt, unfiltered way of speaking was unchanged from before his death. And his forcefulness made Kyousuke smile against his will. Persuaded by Kai, Kyousuke confronts the world of music once more and rediscovers the joy of creating sound together.



But the happy times with Kai wouldn't last forever...


(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

items.title: Принимая пули в котелок
items.alt: Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara 鍋に弾丸を受けながら
items.description: Познакомьтесь с Джунтаро, японским любителем рыбной ловли, который родился и вырос в одном из самых суровых уголков Японии. Именно через его призму вы сможете познакомиться с различными уголками мира, их культурой и, конечно же, их кухней. Он особенно любит посещать страны и города, которые также считаются крайне опасными из-за его личной уверенности в том, что там обязательно будет вкусная еда. Поскольку фильм был рассчитан на японскую аудиторию, вы также сможете увидеть различные картины мира, характерные только для Японии. Есть только одна проблема: у него экстремальные мозговые способности, и он смотрит на мир через призму милой аниме-девушки.

en: Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara

Meet Juntarou. A Japanese fishing addict who was born and raised in what is perceived to be one of the roughest parts of Japan. It is through his lens where you can experience various parts of the world, their culture, and of course their food. He particularly loves to visit countries and cities that are also believed to be highly dangerous due to his personal belief that they will absolutely have delicious food. Because this was intended for a Japanese audience, you will also get to witness various worldviews unique to Japan alongside it all. There's just one problem:



He has extreme brainrot and views the world through a cute anime girl filter.
ja: 鍋に弾丸を受けながら

items.title: Левша
items.alt: Hidari 左
items.description:
A skilled carpenter/sculptor Jingoro, gets set up by his disciples and loses his right arm and his father in an "accident" during the reconstruction of the Edo Castle. A few decades later… Jingoro is continuing his journey of revenge with his partner “Sleeping Cat” and his weaponized prosthetic arm. People have come to call him Jingoro "Hidari," which means "left" in Japanese.



Jingoro defeats all the foes that has betrayed him, but he learns that Tokugawa Shogunate was behind the murderous event. He searches for clues on who was behind the whole set up, and fights with an army of mechanical soldiers along the way. Finally he confronts the mastermind behind all the killings, but first, he must save the city of Edo by stopping the Edo Castle, now turned into a gigantic weapon of mass destruction!


(Source: Official Website)

items.description:
Normal college student Kazuki Hirasawa finds himself inside the body of Harold Stokes, an evil character in the world of Kazuki's favorite game, Brave Hearts. The problem is, if the game's events go as they should, he'll one day find himself defeated by the hero's party. Will he be able to find a path to survival and avoid his many death flags using the incredible power of Harold Stokes's body and his own knowledge of the game? Join Harold in this magnificent manga adaptation of the work that won the 3rd Shosetsuka ni Naro Contest.



(Source: One Peace Books)

items.alt: 奴隷からの期待と評価のせいで搾取できないのだが
items.description:
The story centers around Allen, a boy who is reincarnated and given the cheat power of regeneration from a goddess. Since his ability to treat all sorts of injuries and illnesses has otherwise limited use, he plans to use the power on enslaved girls to bring about an easygoing harem life. However, his cheat power is so overpowered that the enslaved girls are completely cured and he is instantly overwhelmed with a hectic, bountiful harvest and lifestyle. Allen deals with his embarrassment of riches with his modern know-how, but that only makes the enslaved girls even more proficient, leading to commercial prosperity. 




(Source: Anime News Network)

items.title: Rescue Academia
items.alt: レスキューアカデミア
items.description:
The story will be set in the city of Minamisouma in Fukushima prefecture, and will center around a down-and-out protagonist who gets to know a robot while working rescue efforts. It will depict the friendship and growth of a group of children alongside the robot. Local traditional crafts such as Ouborisoumayaki pottery will appear in the story. Fukushima Gainax is producing the anime to promote Fukushima's "Innovation Coast" initiative that aims to revive industry and tourism in the region after the 2011 earthquake and tsunami.



(Source: Anime News Network)

items.title: Manshuu Ahen Squad
items.alt: 満州アヘンスクワッド
items.description:
“Here in Manchuria, the cheapest thing you'll find is a person's life.”



In 1937, Isamu Higata is sent to the Japan-controlled Chinese puppet state of Manchukuo to serve in its standing army. After losing sight in his right eye during battle, he's banished to an agricultural facility where he's constantly abused by the commanding officers. Then, in a dusty corner, he discovers a field of poppies, the raw materials for opium. In order to raise money for his seriously ill mother, Isamu decides to produce the illicit drug—a choice that sends his future and the fate of all Manchuria into directions unknown.



(Source: K MANGA)

items.title: Daikaijuu Gaea-Tima
items.alt: 大怪獣ゲァーチマ
items.description:
A gigantic monster devastates a small, seaside town. Ten years later, the resilient community has emerged as a tourist destination, when the monster, known as GAEA-TIMA, returns. Miyako, a local hero and survivor of the first attack, pushes to find a scientific solution to the problem of the giant creatures known as “gigantis.” But is humanity capable of responding to violence with anything except more violence?



This captivating new sci-fi manga from the creator of the hit series Colorless is a poignant adventure that puts a modern twist on the kaiju genre’s environmental and anti-war roots. Fans of Godzilla Minus One and Kaiju No. 8 shouldn’t miss GAEA-TIMA the Gigantis!



(Source: Kodansha USA)

items.title: Вознесение слабака с помощью забаганного «прохождения сквозь стену»
items.originalTitle: Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru: Kabe wo Surinuketara, Shokai Clear Houshuu wo Mugen Kaishuu Dekimashita!
items.alt: Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru: Kabe wo Surinuketara, Shokai Clear Houshuu wo Mugen Kaishuu Dekimashita! 最弱な僕は＜壁抜けバグ＞で成り上がる ～壁をすり抜けたら、初回クリア報酬を無限回収できました！～
items.description:
Анри Клитс — авантюрист, у которого за душой лишь один навык: «Уклонение». Ни силы, ни магии, ни особых талантов. Только способность уходить от удара, которая в глазах его отряда выглядит бесполезной. Когда терпение союзников лопается, его с позором выгоняют, оставив без средств и надежды помочь своей больной сестре Эльлет.
Отчаявшись, Анри случайно обнаруживает, что его «Уклонение» работает не так, как он думал. Оно позволяет проходить сквозь стены. Не обходить преграду, не искать обходной путь, а просто шагнуть сквозь камень и оказаться по ту сторону. И если стены подземелья больше не преграда, то и босса, охраняющего сокровище, можно попросту не встречать.
Так Анри находит лазейку, о которой не знает ни один авантюрист. Бонус за первое прохождение подземелья, который обычно получают лишь однажды, теперь можно забирать снова и снова. Но за каждой стеной его ждут не только сокровища, но и те, кто уже заметил странного новичка и хочет понять, откуда у него столько удачи.

en: Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru: Kabe wo Surinuketara, Shokai Clear Houshuu wo Mugen Kaishuu Dekimashita!

The series follows Henry, who is a weak young adventurer trying to earn money for his younger sister. Henry's weak "Evasion" skill gets him kicked out of his party. However, he discovers a glitch that allows him to use "Evasion" to clip through walls and earn the first-time clear reward infinite times. By doing this, he rises from the bottom by boosting his stats and collecting rare items.



(Source: Anime News Network)
ja: 最弱な僕は＜壁抜けバグ＞で成り上がる ～壁をすり抜けたら、初回クリア報酬を無限回収できました！～

items.title: Для горничной это естественно
items.alt: Maid nara Touzen desu. メイドなら当然です。
items.description:
For plain little Nina, working as a maid in the house of Count Mirkwood is her whole world—until a false accusation has her swept out on the streets. Jobless and with nowhere left to turn, Nina decides to set out on her very first solo journey. But Nina isn't just any maid—she's a supermaid! Her talents quickly prove indispensable to the people she meets during her travels. There's Emily, a mage who can't use magic; Astrid, a brilliant inventor whose experiments never quite work; and Tien, an orphan who can't seem to keep a meal down. Meanwhile, back at the Mirkwood household, things go awry in Nina's absence...



None of them realize it yet, but Nina might just be the answer they've all been searching for. Because when this supermaid is on the job, no mess can stand in her way!



(Source: J-Novel Club)

items.title: Jing Wei Wu Jian
items.alt: 泾渭无间
items.description:
Adapted from the JJWXC novel ‘Jing Wei Qing Shang’ by Qing Jun Mo Xiao/Please Don’t Laugh, this is a romantic story about two incredible young women.  



Legend says that the land was once separated by the Luo river. 



To the south was the agricultural Wei kingdom, and to the north, the nomadic Jing kingdom. 



Agula, a Princess of the Jing kingdom, had to become a Prince since birth so that her loving parents could stay together. Nangong Jingnu, a Princess of the Wei kingdom, was meant to live a carefree life, but the political struggles of the court made it necessary for her to follow the footsteps of her father. 



After a war turned Agula into an orphan, she went into hiding for ten years, honing her skills in order to infiltrate the Wei kingdom as a sycophantic official and bring chaos to the world. However, due to a series of events, she was appointed to be Nangong Jingnu’s husband at the Qionglin banquet…

items.description: Нацуки Амакуса - талантливый молодой детектив из столичного полицейского управления Токио. Однажды он встречает Юю Шики, старшеклассницу, обладающую таинственной способностью видеть "отметины" на убийцах. После того, как Юя помогает раскрыть сложное дело об убийстве, Нацуки решает завербовать его. Они объединяются в качестве партнеров для расследования различных уголовных дел, одновременно пытаясь раскрыть тайну скрытой силы Юи.

en: Gifted

One day, Amakusa Natsuki—the hope of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department—meets an unusual high schooler named Shiki Yuuya. Natsuki's interest in the high schooler is piqued after Yuuya happens to be passing through the scene of a difficult murder case and determines the perpetrator with ease. How did he know who the killer was? When an incident later takes place at Yuuya's high school, the two happen across each other again... Thus, a young policeman and a high schooler with a hidden power begin unraveling the mystery!

items.alt: こちら、終末停滞委員会。
items.description:
Our world is actually falling apart, unbeknownst to most. A bizarre apparatus hiding in the depths of Ueno's Shinobazu Pond, a giant snail clinging onto the Eiffel Tower, a demon lord in the form of a beautiful girl... these and countless other cryptic entities—called "Ends"—are driving us closer to the apocalypse. However, some youngsters decided to reject that fate and secretly took up arms.



They are fighting, not to stop the countdown or to eradicate the threats, but only to delay the inevitable. Why would they choose such a thorny path on their own volition? To make the most out of their youth in this godforsaken world! I, a former cartel slave (and ESPer), have had a pretty shit life so far, to be honest. But maybe here I'll be able to lead a fulfilling school life, at least?



(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

items.description:
The new series from Tomoko Ninomiya, creator of Nodame Cantabile, turns its focus on the world of jewelry! Shinobu, a second-year in high school, is part of the family that runs Kurata-ya, a storied pawn shop based in a breezy central Tokyo neighborhood. She helps run the place when school isn’t calling, and she has a natural gift that aids her a great deal—the ability to see the “aura” released by gemstones! Shinobu doesn’t have a boyfriend, but she does have a fiancé handpicked for her by her grandfather—Akisada Kitagami, a man from a prestigious family who wound up being taken in by Kurata-ya at a young age. He now works as a salesman for a first-class jewelry brand, but he’s also got more than his fair share of secrets…



(Source: K MANGA)

items.title: Aoharu Once More
items.alt: アオハル・ワンスモア
items.description:
Hayato Kobayashi dreams of his high school days, of the soft wind blowing by and the light streaming in through the window onto the beautiful Ritsu Onishi, and of his dazzling smile. Ritsu would sit in the empty library, surrounded by an air of still beauty. 



One day, as Hayato's eyes are drawn to Ritsu's soft silhouette under the bright sunlight, Hayato's body moves on its own and places a kiss on Ritsu's lips. Since that day, the two became something more than friends, but not yet boyfriends. The two boys live every day like they're walking on clouds through their vague relationship. It was far too late when Hayato finally realized he was in love. Now as an adult, the two had drifted apart after entering different universities and entering the job market. But who knew that Hayato would one day see that beautiful man of his dreams again...?



(Source: TOKYOPOP)

items.alt: 聊天群的日常生活
items.description:
On a certain day, Song Shuhang accidentally joined a deeply afflicted Xianxia chuunibyou(Year 2 middle school disease) chat group, the group members inside all address each other as ‘fellow daoist’. Their contact cards are all either Sect Master, Cave Master, Spiritual Master or Heavenly Expert. Even the group master’s missing pet dog named Great Devil Dog abandoned his home. They chat all day about things like concocting pills, intruding mysterious territories, martial arts experiences and more.



One day, he abruptly realizes after lurking for a long time that…… In this group, every single group member is actually a real cultivator, with the ability to move mountains and drain seas, the kind that can live for thousands of years!



Ah ah ah ah, his worldview has utterly collapsed in a single night!

items.title: Номенклатура ночи
items.alt: Ye de Mingming Shu 夜的命名术
items.description: Родители Цинчэня развелись, когда он был совсем маленьким. Не желая обременять мать, он добровольно остался жить с отцом, одержимым азартными играми. Но однажды на руке юноши появился загадочный обратный отсчёт, и с этого момента жизнь Цинчэня изменилась навсегда. Этот отсчёт связал два совершенно разных мира — и в тот миг, когда цифры достигли нуля, время замерло, а пространство разлетелось на осколки. Так Цинчэнь оказался заброшен сквозь время и пространство в опасную Тюрьму №18, что находилась в другом мире. Под нависающим стальным небом он, полагаясь лишь на смелость и смекалку, шаг за шагом пробивал себе путь вперёд, преодолевая одно испытание за другим, пока не привлёк внимание полубога Ли Шутуна. В конце концов Цинчэнь удостоился чести стать его учеником — и теперь Ли Шутун поведёт юношу по самой длинной из всех дорог, что существуют среди кратчайших путей этого мира.

en: Ye de Mingming Shu

After a difficult upbringing, Qingchen's life takes a drastic turn when a mysterious countdown emerges on his arm. He is taken to Prison No. 18, a dangerous parallel universe, when it reaches zero. He overcomes severe adversity and gains the respect of the demigod Li Shutong by using his cunning and bravery. He then becomes his disciple and embarks on a journey of genuine transformation.

items.title: Девять методов вознесения
items.alt: Deng Xia Jiu Fa 登霞九法
items.description:
Чу Шэн — уличный хулиган, случайно оказавшийся в мире культивации. Надеясь найти защиту в одной из сект, он вскоре выясняет, что легендарные «Девять законов вознесения» скрывают зловещую тайну: эта техника требует человеческих жертв и служит источником силы для бессмертных.
Мир будущего уже давно оказался во власти нечисти, а люди превратились в расходный материал для тех, кто стремится к вечной жизни. Осознав истинную цену бессмертия, Чу Шэн собирает необычную команду единомышленников и отправляется в опасное путешествие, чтобы противостоять злым духам и запретным искусствам.
На пути героев ждут ожесточённые сражения и немало абсурдных ситуаций. Однако дорога к бессмертию оказывается испытанием, где каждый новый день может стать последним.

en: Deng Xia Jiu Fa

Chu Sheng, a street punk, accidentally stumbles into the world of cultivation. Hoping to latch onto an immortal sect to easily counterattack and win at life, he discovers instead that the "Nine Laws of Ascension" is a psychotic evil art that uses living people as nourishment. The future world has long since been refined into a land crawling with evil spirits, and even Chu Sheng himself, a Heavenly Dao Walker with the ability to "merge all things", is nothing more than a spare ration for the immortals.


Gathering a group of absurd teammates, he travels to the future to purge the evil spirits, using his Heavenly Dao abilities to clash head-on with evil arts in blood-and-flesh combat filled with nonsensical humor. The path to ascension offers only one chance of survival in ten thousand. Want to become an immortal? Survive tonight first.



(Source: BiliBili, translated)

items.title: Я убираю мусор в опустошённом мире
items.originalTitle: Wo Zai Feitu Shijie Sao Laji
items.alt: Wo Zai Feitu Shijie Sao Laji 我在废土世界扫垃圾
items.description: Чжу Нин, воительница, крушившая направо и налево орды зомби во время апокалипсиса, неожиданно погибает и попадает в пустошь, полную загадок и фантастических опасностей. Здесь она становится гражданином пятого класса — самого низшего сословия в этом мире, вынужденной зарабатывать на жизнь «сбором мусора». Однако именно эта работа помогает ей раскрыть всю странность и опасность нового мира: причудливых монстров-осквернителей, непонятные законы мироздания и даже собственную, необъяснимую сущность… Постепенно Чжу Нин приближается к разгадке колоссальной тайны, скрытой в самой основе этого мира, — и это открытие навлекает на неё смертельную угрозу. В этой неведомой постапокалиптической реальности героине предстоит вступить в водоворот сложных конфликтов, ища истину о себе самой и об окружающем мире.

en: Wo Zai Feitu Shijie Sao Laji

Zhu Ning, a warrior who slayed in all directions in a zombie apocalypse, unexpectedly dies and is transported to a wasteland filled with unknowns and fantasy. She becomes a fifth-class citizen, the lowest rank in the world, forced to make a living by "scavenging garbage." However, she discovers the strangeness and danger of this world in her work: various bizarre polluting monsters, the world's strange operating rules, and even her own strange self… Zhu Ning gradually uncovers a huge secret hidden behind the world, which also brings her immense danger. In this unknown post-apocalyptic world, Zhu Ning is forced into complex conflicts, searching for the truth about herself and the world.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

A thousand years ago, pieces of a meteorite with massive energy fell on multiple places in the world. They were called "fragments of God". Humans started wars for them. In a certain city, the lord sacrificed himself in resistance against the evil force to protect the residents. When the war came to an end, mechanics rebuilt the city and founded St. Beroro Academy, a dream school for mechanics to pursue their dreams...
